description: Cancel an existing booking. Free cancellation 12+ hours before pickup — no fee, full refund. Under 12 hours the booking cannot be cancelled online: call +44 20 8688 7744 (6–12 hours before pickup 50% of the fare is charged, under 6 hours there is no refund). Under 12 hours before pickup this tool cannot cancel; the office handles it by phone. Identity is the booking reference plus the email address used on the booking (the same login as the website manage-booking page); the API rejects a mismatch. The tool refuses without customer_confirmed: true.

booking_ref.description: Booking reference — the numeric reservation ID shown on the confirmation email and the manage-booking page (e.g. "1013869").

customer_confirmed.description: Must be true: the customer has approved cancelling this specific booking (reference, date, route) after being told the cancellation terms. The tool refuses without it.

email.description: Passenger email on the booking — required, must match exactly

name: cancel_booking
